identity.question: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the December 2026 meeting?

frozen_rule.rate: upper bound of target federal-funds range
frozen_rule.comparison: post-Dec 8-9 level vs level immediately before that meeting
frozen_rule.rounding: change not in displayed options rounds UP to nearest 25 bp; 12.5 bp => 25 bp
frozen_rule.resolution: Dec 2026 FOMC statement; Fed open-market page also publishes level/change
frozen_rule.fallback: no statement by end of next scheduled meeting => No change

calendar_baseline.schedule: Oct 27-28, 2026 meeting precedes Dec 8-9 meeting; next meeting Jan 26-27, 2027 (official Fed calendar captured Oct 21).

calendar_baseline.critical: October action is intermediate and pending. December baseline is the target upper bound immediately before Dec 8; do not carry forward 4.00% if October changes it. If no Dec statement by Jan 27 meeting end, apply frozen fallback.
